items.name: dot-orb
items.title: Dot Orb
items.description: A sphere of dots spinning on its vertical axis, with far-side dots shrinking and fading for depth.

items.name: dot-cascade
items.title: Dot Cascade
items.description: A still dot sphere where each row takes a full 360° turn in a staggered wave from top to bottom.

items.name: dot-lift
items.title: Dot Lift
items.description: A still dot sphere where each ring pushes outward and settles back into place in a staggered wave from top to bottom.

items.name: dot-tide
items.title: Dot Tide
items.description: A dot sphere where a narrow wave travels down, pulling a few rows of dots inward as it passes.

items.name: circle-pulse
items.title: Circle Pulse
items.description: A flat circle of dots where a ring of swollen dots spreads from the center to the edge.

items.name: square-pulse
items.title: Square Pulse
items.description: A flat square of dots where a ring of swollen dots spreads from the center to the edge.

items.name: circle-breath
items.title: Circle Breath
items.description: A flat circle of dots that grows and shrinks together, with optional center-to-edge ripple.

items.name: square-breath
items.title: Square Breath
items.description: A flat square of dots that grows and shrinks together, with optional center-to-edge ripple.

items.name: circle-wave
items.title: Circle Wave
items.description: A flat circle of dots that breathes in a sweep from left to right.

items.name: square-wave
items.title: Square Wave
items.description: A flat square of dots that breathes in a sweep from left to right.

items.name: noise-rings
items.title: Noise Rings
items.description: Thin concentric rings warped by smooth Perlin noise, rippling in soft curves.

items.name: arc-rings
items.title: Arc Rings
items.description: Concentric rings broken into arcs by evenly spaced cuts, rotating around the center.
